note: Counts are read from the committed data files and go stale after every sync. Re-run each repro command before quoting a number as current. This site is a derived, unofficial tracker; the upstream GitHub Releases pages are authoritative.

claims.claim: The committed OpenClaw dataset contains 165 releases grouped into 11 monthly archives, covering 2025-11 through 2026-09.
claims.metric: number of release objects across all month objects in openclaw_data.js
claims.method: loaded the committed data file and counted release objects; month range taken from the monthId fields

claims.claim: The committed Hermes Agent dataset contains 14 releases grouped into 3 monthly archives, covering 2026-07 through 2026-09.
claims.metric: number of release objects across all month objects in hermes_data.js
claims.method: loaded the committed data file and counted release objects; month range taken from the monthId fields

claims.claim: The committed datasets hold 8196 parsed OpenClaw feature entries and 87 parsed Hermes Agent feature entries, each carrying a category tag and a summary.
claims.metric: number of feature objects across every release in openclaw_data.js and hermes_data.js respectively
claims.method: loaded each committed data file and counted feature objects across all releases

claims.claim: The site publishes 3 HTML pages from the repository root, all three listed in sitemap.xml.
claims.metric: number of .html files at the repository root, which is the directory the Pages workflow uploads
claims.method: listed the repository root and compared it against the loc entries in sitemap.xml
